# Daniel Hurtado — Software Engineer | Backend, Fintech & ML

> Software Engineer specializing in Backend, Fintech & ML. Building cross-border payment infrastructure processing $300M+ at Capa.fi. Based in Colombia, working remotely across Latin America, USA, and Europe.

## About

Daniel Hurtado is a Colombian software engineer based in Colombia, specializing in backend architecture, fintech systems, and machine learning. He currently works at Capa.fi building cross-border payment infrastructure that processes over $300 million USD in transaction volume across Mexico, USA, Europe, and Dominican Republic.

Daniel is a systems thinker who approaches engineering problems with an architectural mindset — designing clean domain boundaries, event-driven patterns, and distributed transaction systems for financial applications. He combines deep backend expertise with machine learning capabilities, particularly in fraud detection and risk scoring for fintech applications.

He holds a BS in Computer Science and Technology from the Monterrey Institute of Technology and Higher Education (ITESM) with a GPA of 96.2 out of 100. He is AWS certified and has completed the Alchemy Ethereum Developer Bootcamp.

## Core Expertise — Backend Architecture

Designing and building scalable APIs, microservices, and event-driven systems with clean domain boundaries and bulletproof reliability for financial transactions.

Technologies: TypeScript, NestJS, Node.js, Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ

Key capabilities:
- Event-driven architecture with message queues (RabbitMQ, SQS/SNS)
- Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Clean Architecture patterns
- Microservices with well-defined bounded contexts
- API design (REST, WebSocket) with idempotency guarantees
- Database design and optimization for high-throughput financial systems

## Core Expertise — Fintech & Payments
